messages:
Neha: heads up — seeing mismatched billing attribution for requests routed through the project-proxy service account. console shows org=redwood-marketing but billing is charged to org=redwood-ops.
Mike: repro? any request examples or headers we can look at?
Neha: minimal repro: curl below — token is the proxy SA we mint for cross-project jobs
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer SA_TOKEN' -H 'X-Request-Origin: org:redwood-marketing;proj:marketing-42' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
But router logs show claim.project=proxy-service and telemetry label auth_project=proxy-service.
Jason: that matches the current exchange flow: when we mint the proxy token we collapse origin -> effective claims (we rewrite project claim to the proxy). Router then attributes based on claim.project not the original header.
Anna: any security concerns if we propagated original origin? we intentionally drop it to avoid spoofing right?
Neha: we sign the origin in the minting step (origin_claim signed into token metadata). we could expose both: effective_project (what the runtime uses for RBAC) and origin_project (for billing/telemetry).
Sarah: for console UX I vote we show two columns: "Effective project" and "Origin (billing)" with a tooltip explaining "origin is the original project that triggered the request; effective is the runtime identity after exchange". small mock tooltip text: "Origin is preserved from the initial request at token mint time and used for billing and audit."
Mike: telemetry-wise we should emit two labels on the auth metric: redwood_auth_requests{auth_effective="proxy-service", auth_origin="marketing-42"}. That lets downstream billing pipelines group by auth_origin while SLO/ACL checks still use auth_effective.
Jason: implementation plan: add origin_claim to token payload (already present), update router to read origin_claim when emitting metrics and dashboard events, but leave RBAC path untouched. Add config flag `propagate_origin_for_telemetry: true` behind a feature flag for canary.
Neha: can we do a 5% canary in staging -> prod? infra-bot: deploy bot scheduled a staging rollout tomorrow 09:00 UTC, canary rollout window available.
Sarah: also need a migration/ETL note for billing: historical logs indexed by claim.project will miss origin. we should emit a one-off process to backfill billing attribution where mint event contains origin_claim. I'll file an action item.
Mike: agree. Also add sampling to the new metric (10% default) to avoid cardinality spike if origin has many projects. label cardinality matters.
Anna: security review: we'll ensure origin_claim is only readable by telemetry and billing consumers, not by tenants. token encoder already signs it; adjust ACLs on the token metadata storage.
Jason: config snippet proposed:
```
auth.exchange:
  enable_origin_for_telemetry: true
  origin_sampling_rate: 0.1
```
Neha: perfect. I'll draft the console tooltip copy and a short internal RFC. who wants to review the telemetry schema?
Mike: I'll take telemetry schema + Prometheus name conventions.
Sarah: I'll PR the console change (UI) and write the tooltip copy.
Neha: thanks — moving to action items: Neha->RFC, Mike->metrics PR, Sarah->UI PR, Jason->router canary, Anna->security signoff. infra-bot: please schedule 5% canary after approvals. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: noted — staging deploy tomorrow, canary window available.```
